description: Use when someone asks whether a passport holder can enter mainland China without a visa, and for how long. Inputs: "nationality" (English country name, e.g. "Germany"). Output: JSON with visa_free_for_ordinary_passports, max_days, and every applicable route (30-day unilateral exemption, mutual agreements, 240-hour transit, Hainan 30-day) with conditions, validity dates and official NIA/MFA/embassy source links; dataset last checked 2026-10-18. Not legal advice. Cost: 1 prepaid credit per call with "Authorization: Bearer <key>"; without credits it returns a 402 payment_required result with buy links (see get_pricing).

nationality.description: Country name in English, e.g. "Germany", "United States".

name: check_visa_free_eligibility
title: Check China visa-free eligibility
